essence: An all-in-one broken-CRT / analog-TV composite. It bundles many artifact generators into one effect: horizontal signal tearing & warp, vertical/horizontal roll (hold slippage / roll-bars), color-gun (per-channel RGB) misregistration, analog snow/noise, CRT scanlines, ghosting (double image), diagonal interference lines, and color degradation/desaturation. The canonical 坏电视 / dead-signal / VHS-death look — reach for it when you want a whole TV-breakdown composite rather than a single glitch band (that's Cross Glitch's job).
manifests_as: source torn & horizontally warped into wavy bands with roll-bars, RGB color fringing, scanlines, snow and interference — probe-confirmed. The tearing/roll are partly TIME-DRIVEN (Signal Strength + Breaking Frequency + rolling speeds animate); a still catches whatever phase the break is in.

key_levers.name: Signal Strength
key_levers.effect: MASTER severity of the signal breakup/tearing (gated together with Min/Max Signal Threshold below). Drives how much the source tears and warps. Default 60 already reads heavily broken. Higher = more severe (direction inferred, medium confidence).

key_levers.name: Breaking Frequency
key_levers.effect: rate at which the signal breaks/tears over time — like a glitch interval. Higher = more frequent break events. Time-driven (see manifests_as).

key_levers.name: Distorted Amount
key_levers.effect: magnitude of the horizontal tear/warp displacement — how far the torn bands smear sideways. The wavy horizontal smearing seen in the probe default. Pair with Edge Jaggedness (8192051) + Edge Shapes (8192052) for the tear-edge character.

key_levers.name: Noise Amount
key_levers.effect: analog snow/static density. 100 = full-screen colored TV-snow (dead-channel look) — probe-confirmed. Pair Noise Size (8192022) for grain scale.

key_levers.name: Scanline Alpha
key_levers.effect: opacity of the CRT scanlines. Low = faint, 100 = bold black venetian-blind scanlines (probe-confirmed). Pair Thickness (8192014), Spacing (8192017), Smoothing (8192018) for scanline pitch/softness.

key_levers.name: Color Gun Offset (Red/Green/Blue)
key_levers.effect: 2D per-channel RGB misregistration — Red (8192032), Green (8192035), Blue (8192038) offsets. Shift them apart for the classic misaligned-color-channel / chromatic-split fringing (probe-confirmed).

key_levers.name: Degraded Amount
key_levers.effect: color degradation toward monochrome/tint. 100 = full greyscale (probe-confirmed). Degraded To (8192026, 1-2) picks monochrome vs the Tint Color (8192027).

key_levers.name: Ghost Strength
key_levers.effect: double/multi-image ghosting intensity — Ghost Count (8192041, 0-10) sets how many echoes, Ghost Distance (8192042 px) their spacing.

key_levers.name: Lines Strength
key_levers.effect: diagonal interference-line pattern intensity (probe: dotted diagonal lines). Direction (8192046 deg) + Spacing (8192047) set angle/pitch.

key_levers.name: V-Rolling Speed
key_levers.effect: vertical roll — the black hold-bar that slides up/down the frame (vertical-hold slippage). H-Rolling Speed (8192055) is the horizontal analogue. Offsets: V (8192005) / H (8192056).

key_levers.name: Interference
key_levers.effect: general signal interference amount layered over the image.

key_levers.name: Seed
key_levers.effect: randomization seed for the whole break/noise pattern — change to get a different instance of the same damage.

config_recipes.subtle bad-reception: Signal Strength 20-40, Noise 10-20, Scanline Alpha 10-20, small Color Gun Offset, Distorted 10-20
config_recipes.heavy broken TV: Signal Strength 70-100, Distorted 60-100, Breaking Frequency 100-300, Noise 30-60, Ghost Strength 40
config_recipes.dead-channel snow: Noise Amount 100 (full static), Signal Strength low
config_recipes.clean retro CRT: Scanline Alpha 40-70 + Thickness, small RGB gun offset, Degraded 20-40, low Signal Strength/Noise
config_recipes.VHS chroma-bleed: Color Gun Offset Red/Blue split + Degraded 30-50 + Noise 20 + Ghost Strength 20

reasoning_hooks.more broken / worse signal: raise Signal Strength + Distorted Amount + Breaking Frequency
reasoning_hooks.add color-channel misalignment / chromat: offset the Red / Green / Blue guns apart
reasoning_hooks.desaturate / old-TV color: raise Degraded Amount (Degraded To picks mono vs tint)
reasoning_hooks.add a ghost / double image: Ghost Strength + Ghost Count + Ghost Distance
reasoning_hooks.not showing breakup in a still: the tear/roll are time-driven — scrub in time, or raise Breaking Frequency / Signal Strength / Distorted Amount
reasoning_hooks.make it subtler: lower Signal Strength + Distorted Amount, keep only Scanline/Noise low

grounding: introspect card (198 leaf params, full SEMANTIC names + ranges + units — cards/BCC4Damaged_TV.json) + 6-frame visual probe on a Fractal-Noise+Tint textured base (introspect/frames/ess_dtv_*: default = heavy warp+roll-bar+torn edge; noise100 = full color snow; scanA100 = bold scanlines; gunsplit = RGB channel separation; lines100 = diagonal interference dots; degrade100 = full greyscale) + model prior on BCC Damaged TV. Confidence: high on the isolated artifact levers; medium on Signal-Strength direction and the exact time-gating of break/roll.
_method: introspect + focused probe + synth (the essence-card pipeline)
